segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמּוּדָּר הֲנָאָה מֵחֲבֵירוֹ, שׁוֹקֵל לוֹ אֶת שִׁקְלוֹ וּפוֹרֵעַ אֶת חוֹבוֹ, וּמַחֲזִיר לוֹ אֶת אֲבֵידָתוֹ. מָקוֹם שֶׁנּוֹטְלִין עָלֶיהָ שָׂכָר — תִּפּוֹל הֲנָאָה לַהֶקְדֵּשׁ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one prohibited by vow from deriving benefit from another,» if that other person chooses, «he may contribute the half-shekel» to the Temple «on his» behalf, «and repay his debt, and return his lost item to him,» and the one prohibited from benefiting is not considered to have benefited from him. In «a place where one takes payment» for returning a lost item, that «benefit should fall into» the category of «consecrated» Temple property.

moves.cueHe: המודר הנאה מחבירו, שוקל לו את שקלו
moves.summary: Paying obligations and returning a lost item are permitted

positions.claim: Paying his shekel, repaying his debt and returning his lost item are permitted; a customary finder's fee goes to hekdesh
